name: (19) Presence — 3 Advanced — Pulse of the City

system.description:
Your reach expands to the emotional climate of an entire region. The population around you unconsciously mirrors your moods, and you may cast your feelings across a small city.

The power is always in effect: your emotional state is reflected in the local populace. To deliberately project a chosen emotion, spend a Willpower Trait and make a Static Social Challenge (the Storyteller sets 10-15 opposing Traits by the city's size). On a success you change the emotional climate for one minute; spend additional Social Traits before the challenge to extend the duration. Residents and those with strong ties to the city are affected most strongly, while vampires and other supernatural creatures are affected one level lower than mortals.
system.bloodCost: One Willpower Trait (plus Social Traits to extend duration)
system.duration: One minute per activation, longer with extra Social Traits spent
